## What this book describes

| | |
|---|---|
| Concept model and reference application | [`cdisc-org/analysis-concepts`](https://github.com/cdisc-org/analysis-concepts) at `739344c`, the commit every screenshot is stamped with |
| Study | [TORIVA-LUNG 301](https://github.com/OpenTrialReporting/torivumab-nsclc-301) — fully synthetic, fictional sponsor and drug, educational use only. Documents at `0f78331`; the runs are stamped `a806630`, the commit before it, whose datasets the later one does not change |
| Not upstream's | The R implementation of the mixed model for repeated measures that the second endpoint runs on. At `739344c` the library defines the method and ships a template for it and no implementation; the one used here was written for this book and is injected into the application when the walkthrough serves it. Stage 6 says so where the figure appears |
| Protocol template | ICH M11, in its merged electronic form |
| Study definition model | USDM v4.0 |

Every screenshot names the commit it was taken at. The figures are read from the recorded runs
at build time rather than typed, so a figure here and the run that produced it cannot disagree.

## Attribution

Content based on [CDISC Analysis Concepts (GitHub)](https://github.com/cdisc-org/analysis-concepts)
used under the [CC-BY-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) license.

TORIVA-LUNG 301 is used under CC BY 4.0. It is a **fully synthetic** study: all identifiers,
patient data, drug names and results are invented, the sponsor and the drug do not exist, and
none of it is suitable for regulatory use or for any clinical conclusion.

## Status

This book was drafted with an AI model under the author's direction. The author read it
chapter by chapter on 2026-09-28 and 2026-09-29, with corrections applied and committed as each
chapter was read; the repository's `PROVENANCE.md` records the pass. It was revised on
2026-10-02 at the author's direction — where each concept comes from, why each choice is made,
and less of the working record — and the same file records how far that revision was reviewed.

That is a review of the writing. It is not independent verification of every claim in it: the
lessons in these chapters are drawn from the working record of one traverse, and the repository
behind this book distinguishes what was established by running something from what is argument —
see its `PROVENANCE.md`.

The same repository records its own errors, which is the more useful disclosure. Several
findings made during the work had a premise or a proposed fix disproved, and most of those
failed the same way: by inferring what an application does from reading its files rather than
running it. Treat what follows as a careful account of one traverse rather than as a
specification.

## The repository behind this

Everything here is generated from
[`Lovemore-Gakava/usdm-acdc-in-practice`](https://github.com/Lovemore-Gakava/usdm-acdc-in-practice),
which carries the working record — the authored chains, the executed runs, the comparisons, and
the decisions taken along the way, including the ones that were reversed. The book, like the
repository, is under the MIT licence; the upstream content it reproduces stays under CC-BY-4.0,
and the study under its own CC BY 4.0, as stated above.
